notes.title: Vision - Update
notes.content:
Added Steam Workshop support
UI now uses touch instead of laser pointers
Wrist menu for easy switching of visuals
Horizontal mode for lying down
Added option to disable smooth turning
Improved a bunch of visuals and added a couple
Bug fixes and increased stability

notes.title: Vision - Update
notes.content:
Added Playlist Controls menu with new options
Added Auto Play option to automatically change Visuals at a specified interval
Added ability to randomly choose Visual, Config and Viewpoint
Added basic Audio Controls (Play/Pause, Previous, Next, Stop)
Added option to disable Visual names

notes.title: Vision - Update
notes.content:
Added optional Sky Sphere to Comet Chase, Spirograph and Trails visuals
Added "No Audio Detected" message for clarity
Triggers can now also be used to select UI items
Disabled movement while UI is visible
Added a bit of dead zone to the turning
